title.zh: 将甲米地省伊穆斯市镇第二梅迪西翁村梅迪西翁小学的名称变更为Dominador Camerino省长小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Medicion Elementary School, in Medicion 2nd, Municipality of Imus, Province of Cavite, to Gov. Dominador Camerino Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Medicion Elementary School, in Medicion 2nd, Municipality of Imus, Province of Cavite, to Gov. Dominador Camerino Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Medicion tại Đô thị Imus, Tỉnh Cavite thành Trường Tiểu học Gov. Dominador Camerino
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Medicion ในเทศบาล Imus จังหวัด Cavite เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Gov. Dominador Camerino
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Medicion di Kotamadya Imus, Provinsi Cavite menjadi Sekolah Dasar Gov. Dominador Camerino
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Medicion di Perbandaran Imus, Wilayah Cavite kepada Sekolah Rendah Gov. Dominador Camerino

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6711_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Medicion Elementary School in the Municipality of Imus, Province of Cavite, is hereby changed to Gov. Dominador Camerino Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without executive approval, February 10, 1989.
